title: Companion PR intake and background recovery
description: Native iOS validation with real gateway receipts. Supply INTAKE_PR_URL/PROJECT/SLOT/GW_URL and matching params. Uses a disabled slot and unavailable provider account. The pr_key parameter uses lowercase owner/repo#number.

check-existing-work.intent: Refuse to interfere with existing operator intake for this PR.

prepare-team.intent: Create or refresh the disabled-slot validation team through real RPCs and clean its setup request.

open-prs.intent: Open the real Companion monitoring route on the assigned simulator.

wait-panel.intent: The connected native screen exposes shared gateway PR work.

enter-pr.intent: The individual review targets the supplied PR without depending on an originating Farmslot run.

choose-team.intent: The request inherits the disabled-slot validation team policy.

override-review.intent: Choose explicit review and QA settings while inheriting the disabled slot.

choose-live.intent: Require live QA while continuing the saved reviewer context.

submit-request.intent: Submit through the production intake API.

wait-request.intent: Verify provider failure is visible on the persisted request.

verify-request.intent: Assert the gateway received the selected team, Continue and live QA settings, with no dispatch.

capture-request.intent: Reviewers can inspect the persisted failure state and available cancellation control.

cancel-request.intent: Cancel the request using its real UI control.

verify-cancelled.intent: Verify cancellation persisted and no work is queued.

hide-keyboard.intent: Finish entering the URL so team controls remain accessible.

background.intent: Opening another app to copy a URL must not discard the draft.

return.intent: Returning to Companion reconnects and preserves the draft and request identity.

draft-preserved.intent: The review form survives native backgrounding and reconnect.

open-team-picker.intent: Choose the team policy without expanding the whole team inventory in the form.

find-team.intent: Narrow the native chooser to the disabled-slot validation policy.

hide-team-keyboard.intent: The selected team is reachable after dismissing the search keyboard.

scroll-review-options.intent: The operator can reach validation-depth controls below the session settings.

scroll-submit.intent: The submit control is visible after choosing the review policy.
